summary: Approved character reference sheet for the Patch Mission Controller. The sheet frames the character as the human planner who turns uncertainty into a plan and readiness, showing visual-trait callouts, workspace context, role-in-the-flow statements, and the Patch Mission Support Team footer.

sheet_identity_and_status: Top title reads 'MISSION CONTROLLER' with the tagline 'TURNING UNCERTAINTY INTO A PLAN. PLAN INTO READINESS.'
Asset-class stamp reads 'ASSET CLASS PMC.MC-OI VERSION: 10 DATE: 202505-19 STATUS: APPROVED'.
Bottom banner reads 'PATCH MISSION SUPPORT TEAM' followed by 'We prepare the plan. You make it happen.' and 'PATCH GETS THE CREDIT. WE GET IT DONE.'
character_views_and_poses: The 'CHARACTER VIEWS & POSES' section is present with a 'TRACK TASKS' / 'Trek tasks' callout and a 'UNIFORM TO READY' / 'UNIFOW TO REDY' step.
A 'COMM HEADSET' prop is highlighted with the quote 'I turn fuzzy information into clear next steps. You focus on the mission. I'll handle the starting line.'
visual_traits: The 'VISUAL TRAITS' panel lists 'HAIR BUN', 'BADGE', and 'FACIAL EXPRESSIONS' with 'Aligned' and 'ready' cues.
The 'WORKSPACE CONTEXT' panel lists 'BADGE & LANYARD' with 'Access and Steady' and 'CONFIDENT POSTURE' with 'Ready to lead' / 'firm.'
workspace_and_flow: The workspace is labeled 'PATCH MISSION CONTROL CENTRE' with 'Monitors, data, and team at your fingertips.'

Role-in-the-flow callouts include 'FROM VAGUE TO READY', 'ROLE IN THE FLOW', and the banner 'I PREPARE THE PLAN. YOU CHANGE THE OUTCOME. CLEAR INTAKE. SMART PLANS. SMOOTH LAUNCHES. ONE TEAM. ONE FLOW. ONE MISSION READY.'
Additional panels include 'COLOR PALETTE', 'TEAM CONNECTION', and 'CARGO POCKETS' / 'CARGO PCXKETS'.
